# Safety Requirements Quality Checklist: Warrant X-Ray

**Purpose**: Release-gate review (before `/speckit-tasks`) of how well the requirements define the three hard rules: numbers only from code (grounding), no advice or prediction, and web text as untrusted data.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | detail: [requirements.md](../../../requirements.md) | design: [plan.md](../plan.md), [tech_spec.md](../../../tech_spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Audience**: author, before task generation. **Depth**: formal release gate. **Focus**: grounding, advice boundary, prompt-injection (constitution principles I, II, III, X).

## Grounding: Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the set of "numbers" subject to grounding enumerated (prices, ratios, counts, dates, percentages, days, ranges, evidence ids), or only implied by "every number"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Req §FR-GRD-01]
- [ ] CHK002 Are numbers inside news facts (quoted "exactly as written") explicitly addressed by the grounding rule, including how they are matched? [Gap, Req §FR-NEWS-04, §FR-GRD-01]
- [ ] CHK003 Are numbers typed by the user explicitly in or out of the grounding allowlist, including numbers the user typed in earlier turns? [Gap, Req §FR-GRD-01]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the content of the "safe" fallback answer defined for the case where every sentence is removed by the verifier? [Gap, Req §FR-GRD-02]
- [ ] CHK005 Are grounding requirements stated for outputs other than chat answers (Deep Risk Report, exports, stored or templated answers, optional Discord replies)? [Coverage, Req §FR-DEEP-04, §FR-DSC-02]
- [ ] CHK006 Is a requirement defined for validating that each `[E#]` reference marker actually points to an existing evidence record? [Gap, Req §FR-CHAT-05]

## Grounding: Clarity and Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Is "the same rounding the interface displays" specified precisely enough to decide pass or fail for each number type? [Clarity, Req §FR-GRD-01]
- [ ] CHK008 Do the functional rule (match using interface rounding) and the technical design (exact display-string match with a rounded-numeric fallback) describe the same acceptance behavior? [Consistency, Req §FR-GRD-01, Tech §11]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it clear whether an approximate statement ("about 5%", "roughly doubled") is allowed, and under what matching rule? [Ambiguity, Req §FR-GRD-01]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the two different IV headline bases (mid in the functional spec, size-weighted mid in the technical design) reconciled so a displayed IV has one unambiguous source? [Conflict, Req §FR-CARD-01, Tech §8]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the ILLUSTRATIVE labeling rule for glossary examples consistent with the grounding rule that every number must match retrieved data? [Consistency, Req §FR-CHAT-09, §FR-GRD-01]

## Grounding: Measurability

- [ ] CHK012 Is the grounding pass-rate reporting (first pass, after retry, stripped) given a target or only a "record how often" requirement? [Measurability, Req §FR-GRD-03]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the success criterion "100% of numbers trace to data" define how it will be measured and over what sample of answers? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Advice Boundary: Completeness

- [ ] CHK014 Is the list of prohibited outputs (target, stop-loss, entry level, conviction, return or price prediction) consistent between the constitution, the functional spec and the linter pattern list? [Consistency, Constitution §III, Req §FR-ADV-01, §FR-ADV-03]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the content and wording of the "safe response" that replaces a failing draft defined? [Gap, Req §FR-ADV-03]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for mixed requests that combine a legitimate question with an advice request? [Coverage, Req §FR-ADV-01]
- [ ] CHK017 Is a requirement stated for advice leaking through non-chat surfaces: sample prompts, flag text, Deep Risk Report "what must go right", counterpoints, exported text? [Gap, Req §FR-DEEP-02, §FR-UI-02]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the disclaimer language requirement defined for Malay replies, or is the disclaimer English-only? [Gap, Req §FR-G-03, §FR-CHAT-07]

## Advice Boundary: Clarity

- [ ] CHK019 Is "recommendation language" defined by criteria rather than only an example list, so new phrasings can be judged consistently? [Clarity, Req §FR-ADV-03]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the line between a user-defined scenario result ("what the model computes") and a prediction stated unambiguously? [Ambiguity, Req §FR-ADV-04]
- [ ] CHK021 Could "five warrants nearest to the money" and "highest and lowest value marked" be read as implicit rankings, and do requirements rule that out explicitly? [Ambiguity, Req §FR-STK-04, §FR-CMP-03]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the meaning of flag severity "high" defined as a condition description and not a rating or advice? [Clarity, Req §FR-FLAG-*]
- [ ] CHK023 Are "pressure and rephrasing" test cases specified well enough (kinds, count, languages) to judge FR-ADV-02 as testable? [Measurability, Req §FR-ADV-02]

## Advice Boundary: Measurability

- [ ] CHK024 Does "0 recommendation outputs across the advice-boundary test set" define the size and composition of that set? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the Malay phrase coverage requirement defined (who maintains the pattern list, what minimum coverage)? [Gap, Req §FR-ADV-02, §FR-LANG-01]

## Prompt Injection and Untrusted Text

- [ ] CHK026 Is "instructions inside web text MUST NOT change the system's behavior" specified with observable pass/fail criteria beyond the single acceptance scenario? [Measurability, Req §FR-NEWS-09, §AC-10]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for text the user pastes into chat that contains instructions (as distinct from web text)? [Coverage, Req §FR-ERR-22]
- [ ] CHK028 Are injection requirements stated for every untrusted input path (search snippets, extracted pages, issuer data fields, user-provided URLs), not only news? [Gap, Constitution §X]
- [ ] CHK029 Is it specified what the user sees when an item is dropped for containing instructions, and where the drop is reported? [Gap, Req §FR-NEWS-09, Tech §6]
- [ ] CHK030 Are limits on what a model may request from tools (no model-supplied URLs, call caps) captured as requirements rather than only as design choices? [Gap, Tech §4, §11]

## Citation and Provenance

- [ ] CHK031 Is "source link and a date" defined for undated items consistently between FR-G-04 (omit) and FR-NEWS-03 (show undated)? [Conflict, Req §FR-G-04, §FR-NEWS-03]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the retrieval time requirement from the constitution (URL and retrieval time) reflected in the functional requirements for every news claim? [Consistency, Constitution §II, Req §FR-NEWS-03]
- [ ] CHK033 Is "unconfirmed" (single domain) defined so that two syndicated copies of one wire story are not counted as corroboration? [Clarity, Req §FR-NEWS-05]

## Degraded Modes and Recovery

- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for what safety checks do when the Nano intent check or the verifier itself fails or times out (fail closed vs fail open)? [Gap, Exception Flow, Req §FR-ERR-16]
- [ ] CHK035 Is it specified that stored or templated fallback answers pass the same grounding and advice checks? [Gap, Req §FR-CTRL-02]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the partial-answer behavior on timeout defined to guarantee the partial text is already verified? [Clarity, Req §FR-ERR-17]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that exact display strings are reliably copied by the Nemotron models recorded with a fallback requirement if the verified rate is too low? [Assumption, Tech §D4, §14]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the open question on whether any wording counts as regulated advice in Malaysia tied to a decision point before launch? [Dependency, Req §OI-10]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
